title: anthemis macedonica subsp. stribrnyi
intro: Anthemis macedonica subsp. stribrnyi, commonly known as Macedonian chamomile or Balkan chamomile, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis macedonica subsp. stribrnyi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents also contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for insomnia, digestive issues, and skin conditions.
